name: The chip
plain: The processors that do the AI math
evidence: The cloud giants design their own chips and rivals sell alternatives. Anthropic signed a multi-gigawatt Google and Broadcom chip deal in April 2026 (reported)

name: The system and the network
plain: The links that make thousands of chips act as one computer, sold as full racks
evidence: Networking sales passed $31B in fiscal 2026, and were $11B in Q4 alone, up more than 3.5 times from a year earlier. Rack-sized Grace Blackwell systems were about two-thirds of Data Center sales in Q4 FY26
source: Nvidia Q4 FY26 earnings call (official corrected transcript)

name: The software and platform
plain: The programming tools developers already know, plus services
evidence: Nvidia does not report software revenue. It says it will share in revenue its AI cloud partners earn from third parties 'if certain criteria are met', so none of this is in reported revenue yet
strength: Real, but not measurable from filings
